programs.desc: Game 1 of the Western Conference First Round between the Ducks and the Oilers takes place at Rogers Place. Edmonton holds home-ice advantage as the No. 2 seed in the Pacific Division. The Ducks' Cutter Gauthier leads the team in points and goals.

programs.desc: The Ducks face the Oilers in Game 2 of the West first round at Rogers Place. Edmonton won the opener 7-4 on Jan. 26, fueled by its power play. Connor McDavid leads the Oilers while Cutter Gauthier leads the Ducks. Anaheim looks to even the series.

programs.title: NHL Hockey
programs.desc: The Edmonton Oilers take on the Anaheim Ducks at Honda Center for Game 3 of the West first round. The Ducks won Game 2 to tie the series. Cutter Gauthier's second goal of the night broke a 4-4 tie late in the third period to seal the win.

programs.title: NHL Hockey
programs.desc: The Oilers face the Ducks in Game 4 at Honda Center. Anaheim leads the series after a 7-4 Game 3 win where they broke a 3-3 tie. After Connor McDavid cut it to 5-4, Jeffrey Viel and Jackson LaCombe scored to seal the victory for the Ducks.

programs.title: NHL Hockey
programs.desc: Anaheim Ducks battle Edmonton Oilers in Game 5 of their playoff series at Rogers Place. Anaheim holds a commanding 3-1 series advantage following a thrilling 4-3 overtime victory over Edmonton in Game 4 of the crucial Western Conference matchup.

programs.title: NHL Hockey
programs.desc: The best-of-seven series continues as the Ducks play the Oilers in Game 6 at Honda Center. Edmonton won Game 5, while Anaheim leads the series 3-2. Leon Draisaitl scored a tip-in goal and a power-play one-timer in the 4-1 win to secure the victory.
